Changeset.description: Snapshot workspaces now (their main: the directory as it is).

session.description: Session labelling the workspace when the changeset was taken.

all.description: Also list paths that `.acfsignore` leaves out.

full.description: Compare complete views instead of the upper-layer shortcut (slow; for verification).

patch.description: Unified diff of regular files, with `patch`.

summary_only.description: The snapshot was pruned: `changes` is the summary kept against its parent.

code.description: invalid, not_found, state (not allowed in the current state), exists, exhausted or internal.

base.description:
The changeset or snapshot the changes were made against: refuse them if a path
they touch changed since.

oneOf.description: The changes left the workspace as it was.
Paths the changes touch changed since `base`; nothing was written.

path.description: Path from the workspace root (`fs.stat`) or name in the directory (`fs.list`).

content.description: Base64 content of a regular file (from `offset`).

snap.description: Snapshot read; None for the workspace's directory.

at.description: A changeset or snapshot of the workspace.

FsOp.description: One change of `fs.edit`. New entries belong to the workspace owner.

oneOf.description: Create or replace a regular file; missing parent directories are created.

mode.description: Default: the replaced file's mode, else 0644.

oneOf.description: Create a directory and missing parents.
Remove an entry, with everything below it.
Rename an entry; `to` must not exist.

FsRead.description: `fs.read`: a file's content (from `offset`, at most `length` bytes) or a symlink's target.

at.description: A changeset or snapshot of the workspace.

length.description: At most this many bytes (default: to the end, up to 64 MiB).

at.description: A changeset or snapshot of the workspace.

changeset.description: None when nothing changed since the last changeset.

LiveSpan.description: A stretch of a workspace's history labelled by a session.

end_snap.description: None while the session is active.

MergeResult.description: Merge into one workspace's branch (proc.merge, reset, revert, session.discard).

unused_resolutions.description: Resolutions given for paths that had no conflict.

PathName.description: A path in API messages: a string, or `{"base64": ...}` when it is not UTF-8.

path.description: The workspace's directory; the process sees its branch there.

state.description: open (work not merged yet), conflicted, merged or discarded.

since.description: Record nothing when every branch still equals this changeset's snapshot of its workspace (default: the branch's head).

changeset.description: None when nothing changed (see `since`); no snapshot is kept then.

paused.description: Whether the process was frozen (it was running).

ProcExited.description: `proc.run` (second response line): the process exited and its work was merged.

code.description: Exit code; None when killed by a signal (or unknown after a daemon restart).

state.description:
running, exiting (exited, its work is being merged), conflicted (exited, work not merged yet), merged
or discarded.

sent.description: False when the process was not running.

discard_ws.description: Workspaces whose unmerged changes are dropped (the branch is reset to main).

no_resolver.description: Report conflicts instead of running the resolver.

changeset.description: Snapshot of the process's branches taken before merging.

resolver.description: What the resolver did, when it ran.

results.description: Merges into main, one per workspace with changes.

state.description: The process's state afterwards: running, conflicted, merged or discarded.

updated.description: Running process: main's other changes merged into its branches.

resolver.description: Command run as the caller, in a directory with `TASK.md`, when merging conflicts.

ws.description: Workspaces the process gets a branch of; default: every attached workspace of the caller.

dropped.description: Snapshots whose data was dropped (they keep metadata and a diff summary).

oneOf.description: Take over a directory: acfs mounts the workspace's main over it and records every change made there.
oneOf.title: WsRegisterRequest

oneOf.description: Stop tracking: write the head back to the host directory and unmount.
oneOf.title: WsDetachRequest

oneOf.description: Thin out a workspace's automatic snapshots now (also done periodically).
oneOf.title: WsPruneRequest

oneOf.description: End a session: its workspaces keep their content, the label stops.
oneOf.title: SessionMergeRequest

oneOf.description: End a session and bring its workspaces back to where it started.
oneOf.title: SessionDiscardRequest

oneOf.description:
Run a command as the caller in its own mount namespace, every workspace replaced by
the process's own branch. CLI only: the request carries the caller's stdin, stdout and
stderr (SCM_RIGHTS); a second response line (`ProcExited`) follows when it exits.
oneOf.title: ProcRunRequest

oneOf.description:
The process's task is done: snapshot its branches, merge them into main (the resolver
handles conflicts) and, while it runs, bring main's other changes into its branches.
oneOf.title: ProcMergeRequest

oneOf.description: Signal a running process's group (default SIGTERM).
oneOf.title: ProcKillRequest

oneOf.description: Read a file (or a symlink's target) of a workspace without mounting it.
oneOf.title: FsReadRequest

oneOf.description: List a directory of a workspace.
oneOf.title: FsListRequest

oneOf.description: Change files of a workspace's main and record the change as one changeset.
oneOf.title: FsEditRequest

Reset.description:
Bring a branch back to a changeset or snapshot (recorded as a new changeset): a running
process's branch for its own snapshots, else the workspace's main.

oneOf.description: Keep the target's version.
Take the source's version.
Write the supplied content.

content.description: Base64 file content for action "content" (the CLI reads `content_path`).

Revert.description:
Undo one changeset, everything a session recorded, or everything between two states
(`from`, `to`), on top of the current head.

from.description: Changeset or snapshot the range starts at (not undone); needs `to`.

to.description: Changeset or snapshot the range ends at (undone), of the same workspaces as `from`.

end_on_exit.description:
End (merge) the session once the calling process (the one that connected) exits,
as if its idle timeout had passed. Needs Linux 6.5 (SO_PEERPIDFD). SDK only: the
CLI process exits right away.

idle_timeout.description: End (merge) the session after this many seconds without changes.

ws.description: Workspaces whose changes this session labels (repeatable).

conflict.description: `session.discard`: a workspace could not be brought back (see `live[].discard`).

present.description: False once pruned (only the diff summary against the parent is kept).

dry_run.description: Only report what would be dropped.

stale_processes.description: Processes that were inside the directory when acfs took it over; they see it vanish.

description:
acfs-daemon socket protocol: one JSON request line and one JSON response line per connection
(`proc.run`: a second line, `ProcExited`).
title: AcfsProtocol
